note: W7 (OKNA §6.3): the keys of the window system as data, moved out of layouts.json (window_arrange.keymap). A key combination (modifiers ctrl, alt, shift in this order, then the key as KeyboardEvent.key in lower case) → an operation on the focused window: a side (left/right/top/bottom), tab, float, maximize, minimize, restore, duplicate, or a journal/switcher step (undo, redo, next, prev). An open list of presets: any combination, any operation the window menu knows. In a text field the field keeps its keys. Ctrl+Tab of §6.3 is not a preset because browsers keep it for their own tabs (dated observation 2026-10-27); it works when a person adds it here and the shell (Android) passes it.
